title: Access While a Shortfall Is Open — Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Tier Terms
content:
On the Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan, two tier terms describe how much access remains while a shortfall from an earlier payday is still open.

- **Share of access kept while a shortfall is open** — the percent of the normal percentage and pay-period room that stays available while an open shortfall is within the tolerated amount; 0 means access is withheld (number, percent).
- **Largest tolerated open shortfall** — the largest open shortfall under which reduced access continues (USD); 0.00 means none is tolerated.

| Tier | Share of access kept while a shortfall is open | Largest tolerated open shortfall |
|---|---|---|
| Paystride Access Starter | 0 percent | 0.00 USD |
| Paystride Access Standard | 0 percent | 0.00 USD |
| Paystride Access Plus | 0 percent | 0.00 USD |
| Paystride Access Preferred | 0 percent | 0.00 USD |
| Paystride Access Premier | 50 percent | 100.00 USD |
| Paystride Access Premier Plus | 50 percent | 200.00 USD |

## Points of reading

- On the four lower tiers the share kept is 0 percent and no open shortfall is tolerated: these terms keep no access open on those tiers while a shortfall is open.
- Paystride Access Premier and Paystride Access Premier Plus keep 50 percent; they differ only in the largest tolerated open shortfall, 100.00 USD on Paystride Access Premier and 200.00 USD on Paystride Access Premier Plus.
